passiveEffects.name: Torrent
passiveEffects.originalDescription: When this Pokémon deals damage to opposing Pokémon, or as time passes, the Torrent gauge increases to a max of 100. If a move is used when the Torrent gauge exceeds 50, 50 points of the gauge is consumed and the move becomes boosted. The rate at which the Torrent gauge increases depends on your current HP with thresholds at: above 66% HP, below 66% HP, and below 33% HP. Every second gain 1/2/3 Torrent gauge.

normalAttackEffects.name: Attack
normalAttackEffects.originalDescription: Piplup shoots a blast of water, becoming a boosted attack with every third attack dealing increased damage. Basic and Boosted attacks increase Torrent gauge by 2/3/4. When evolved into Prinplup or Empoleon, basic attacks become melee ranged. The user slices with their wings, becoming a boosted attack with every third attack dealing increased damage. Boosted attack increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20. This Pokémon heals 15% of damage dealt with basic and boosted attacks.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Sovereign Slide
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Has the user slide at high speed in the designated direction and form a whirlpool on impact, or when the maximum distance is reached, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and throwing them for 1s. The whirlpool remains centered on the user for 7s and applies a 50% slow to opposing Pokémon in the area. The slow lasts 1s when opposing Pokémon leave the area. Empoleon is unstoppable throughout this move. The longer the user slides, the faster the recovery to perform other actions. Increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20 when the move connects. While the whirlpool is active the amount of Torrent gauge gained per second is increased to 12/18/24. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
